title: B1: pool.toml [[executors]] table + Pool.pick_executor(role, complexity) + per-executor state
spec:
Why: one hard-coded Codex model (pool.toml [codex] model=gpt-6-astra; executor.py:81) cannot balance work across GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra/Sol (ids confirmed in the Codex models cache: gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-sol) or hold a slot for 6.x ids. Scout T-0012 mapped the readers; blast radius order: Pool.codex_available/Codex dataclass (pool.py:103-121, 43-47) → Pool.pick (pool.py:76) → pool_state.json keying (pool.py:63-72) → model resolution (executor.py:81, spawn.py:124) → log_run.

What (≤5 files: .orchestrator/pool.toml, orchestrator/pool.py, tests/test_orchestrator.py; do NOT touch executor.py or spawn.py in this task):
1. .orchestrator/pool.toml — add:
```
[[executors]]
id = "astra";  provider = "codex"; model = "gpt-6-astra";   roles = ["execute"]; complexity_min = 1; complexity_max = 10; max_parallel = 2; daily_budget_tasks = 40; quota_group = "chatgpt"; weight = 1.0; enabled = true
[[executors]]
id = "luna";   provider = "codex"; model = "gpt-5.6-luna";  roles = ["execute"]; complexity_min = 1; complexity_max = 6;  max_parallel = 2; daily_budget_tasks = 40; quota_group = "chatgpt"; weight = 1.0; enabled = true
[[executors]]
id = "terra";  provider = "codex"; model = "gpt-5.6-terra"; roles = ["execute"]; complexity_min = 1; complexity_max = 6;  max_parallel = 2; daily_budget_tasks = 40; quota_group = "chatgpt"; weight = 1.0; enabled = true
[[executors]]
id = "sol";    provider = "codex"; model = "gpt-5.6-sol";   roles = ["execute"]; complexity_min = 1; complexity_max = 6;  max_parallel = 2; daily_budget_tasks = 40; quota_group = "chatgpt"; weight = 1.0; enabled = true
[[executors]]
id = "luna6";  provider = "codex"; model = "gpt-6-luna";    roles = ["execute"]; complexity_min = 1; complexity_max = 10; max_parallel = 2; daily_budget_tasks = 40; quota_group = "chatgpt"; weight = 1.0; enabled = false   # enable when the id appears in models_cache.json
```
(same disabled placeholders for terra6/sol6). Keep [codex] with home, on_exhausted, dangerous_full_access, and keep `model = "gpt-6-astra"` as the legacy default so executor.py keeps working until B2. Remove the dead key pace_reserve (no readers, T-0012). Add a comment: "quota_group: a usage-limit hit on one member cools the whole group; limit scope per account vs per model is unconfirmed (2026-09-17)".
2. orchestrator/pool.py — (a) `@dataclass Executor` with the fields above plus runtime state cooldown_until: float=0, day_tasks: int=0, running: int=0, day: str=""; (b) Pool loads `cfg["executors"]` into `self.executors: dict[id, Executor]`; when the table is absent, synthesize one executor "astra" from [codex] so old configs and tests keep working; (c) state persistence: pool_state.json gains `"executors": {id: {cooldown_until, day_tasks, running, day}}`, saved/loaded next to accounts and codex; missing entries default; (d) `def pick_executor(self, role: str, complexity: int, scores: dict | None = None) -> Executor | None`: candidates = enabled ∧ role in roles ∧ complexity_min ≤ complexity ≤ complexity_max ∧ not cooling ∧ running < max_parallel ∧ day_tasks < daily_budget_tasks; rank by weight × scores.get(id, 1.0), ties broken by fewest day_tasks then id; return None when empty; (e) `def cooldown_executor(self, ex_id, secs, reason="")`: sets cooldown on that executor AND every enabled executor sharing its quota_group; (f) `codex_available()` returns True iff pick_executor("execute", 1) finds a codex-provider executor (keep the method name; callers unchanged); (g) `status()["executors"]` = list of {id, model, enabled, cooling_s, running, day_tasks}; keep the existing `codex` block computed from the legacy/astra executor so cli/tests keep passing.
3. tests/test_orchestrator.py — add class `Executors`: (a) pick_executor("execute", 3) returns one of astra/luna/terra/sol and never a disabled or out-of-range one (complexity 8 → only astra); (b) cooldown_executor("luna", 600) cools astra/terra/sol too (same quota_group) and pick_executor returns None for complexity 8 while cooling; (c) scores={"terra": 3.0} makes terra win at complexity 3; (d) state round-trips through pool_state.json (save then a fresh Pool() sees the cooldown). Use the TMP pool.toml copy (the test module copies REPO's pool.toml at import, so the new table is present).

Run `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py`. Commit: "pool: [[executors]] table, pick_executor(role, complexity, scores), quota-group cooldowns" with a revert-path body.

Done, committed as `361b7ce` on `task/T-0016`.

## Summary
- `.orchestrator/pool.toml`: added the `[[executors]]` table — 7 rows, 4 enabled (astra 1–10, luna/terra/sol 1–6), 3 disabled 6.x placeholders (luna6/terra6/sol6). Removed the dead `pace_reserve`. Kept `[codex]` with `model = "gpt-6-astra"` as the legacy default plus the quota_group comment. The spec's `id = "x"; provider = "y"` one-liners aren't valid TOML (no statement separator), so each key is on its own line — same values.
- `orchestrator/pool.py`: `Executor` dataclass, `Pool.executors`, `pick_executor(role, complexity, scores)`, `cooldown_executor` (cools the whole quota group), state round-tripping through `pool_state.json`, `status()["executors"]`, and `codex_available()` now delegating to `pick_executor("execute", 1)`.
- `tests/test_orchestrator.py`: new `Executors` class (4 tests); updated the `Cli` JSON-keys assertion to include `executors` and assert 7/4.

Two deliberate deviations worth flagging:
- `_sync_legacy_codex()` folds the legacy `self.codex` cooldown/running/day_tasks into the matching row (via `max`, and a group cooldown for the limit). Without it, `executor.py:55` writing `pool.codex.cooldown_until` on a usage limit would stop gating dispatch, since `codex_available()` no longer reads those counters. This is the bridge until B2 moves executor.py over.
- `Executor` carries a `hold_reason` field (persisted) so `cooldown_executor(..., reason=...)` isn't a dead parameter. Mirrors `Account`.

## Verification
- `uv run python -m unittest tests/test_orchestrator.py` — 28 tests, OK. No failures.
- `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh "$PWD"` — exit 0. (`scripts/tests_green.sh` doesn't exist in this repo; the runner is this hook.)
- `ORCH_ROOT=$PWD uv run orchestrator status` → `executors: 7 enabled: 4`; `pick_executor('execute', 8).id == 'astra'`, `('execute', 3) → astra`, with `scores={'terra': 3.0}` → `terra`.
- `git diff --stat`: only the three in-scope files.

No new dependencies.
